tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light = white; dark = the brand's Dark surface #151025.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section bands, cards and input fields set on `surface`. Dark value is a derived step above Dark surface (not in the brand pack).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and dividers. Decorative only - never the sole boundary of a control (use `ink-muted` borders on inputs). Derived, not in the brand pack.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `surface` and `surface-sunken` (16:1 light, 18:1 dark). Light value is the brand Wordmark/ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and input borders on `surface` and `surface-sunken` (>=5.6:1 both themes). Derived for legibility; not in the brand pack.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Violet thread front - the primary brand colour. Primary buttons and the Helix front strand. `on-violet` text on it (6.1:1). In dark theme do not use as text on `surface` (3:1) - use `accent-text`.

tokens.name: violet-rear
tokens.usage: Violet thread rear - Helix back strand, decorative fills and illustration. Dark value = Reversed thread rear. Not for body text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: violet-tint
tokens.usage: App icon thread rear - soft decorative tint, chips and pattern fills behind ink text.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Orange i dot - the signature accent. Use sparingly: the coming-soon dot, one highlight per view. `on-orange` text on it (6.9:1). Never as text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `violet` fills.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text on `orange` fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and inline emphasis on `surface` / `surface-sunken` (light 6.1:1, dark 7.2:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (>=3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: dark-surface
tokens.usage: Brand Dark surface - fixed dark bands and footers in either theme; pair with `on-violet` (white) text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between heading and content blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside a group, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels - echoes the rounded app-icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the signup panel.
